title: A finished demo is measured with mobile PageSpeed beside the current site's score; outreach offers the proof line only with both
steps: S1: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a disposable PostgreSQL server, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A stubbed PageSpeed answer is kept as the demo's score (mobile strategy, the demo address); a refusal, a network error, a timeout or an answer without a performance score keeps a reason and never a number.

A demo on a reserved or private address (*.test, localhost, a private IP, a port of its own) reads not_public and PageSpeed is never asked; the app's own build hook stores not_public for a *.localhost demo with no outbound call.
The measurement is merged into wo_build.built.pagespeed after the build facts, beside the picture, and a measurer that throws never fails the hook.
GET /api/website-opportunities/:id answers pagespeed {old, demo}; the list row's demo and /ops/wo carry the same; a build without a measurement reads not_measured, no build no_demo.
GET /api/website-opportunities/:id/outreach offers pagespeedProof 'Current site 34 → demo 92 on mobile' only when both scores exist and the demo scores higher; the drafts are worded as before.

tests: a demo PageSpeed score is kept with its facts, measured on mobile at the demo address
a PageSpeed failure keeps its reason and never a number
a PageSpeed run that never answers ends at its bound as timeout, even when fetch ignores the abort
an address PageSpeed cannot reach is never sent to Google
no address, the operator switch and a missing key each keep their reason; a stand reads not_public first
the measurer reads the key and the switch from the runtime and the address Details gives the demo
a finished build keeps its PageSpeed beside its facts, merged into built, alongside its picture
a PageSpeed measurer that throws or a build without a site never fails the hook
the pair reads the old score and the demo view; the proof line only when both scored and the demo is faster
the Live Queue sets the current site score beside the latest demo’s own PageSpeed
Details sets the current site’s PageSpeed beside the demo’s own; outreach offers the proof line only with both
